ache.title: 8 hours and 8 minutes. He timed it. Of course
ache.note: Nero posted this with Zhu Yuan’s banner resetting in ‘8 hours and 8 minutes’. A countdown that exact is pure pressure. He also weighs saving for Qingyi and the Sons of Calydon, so the choice becomes pull now or pull later. Every option ends in pulling. You’re allowed to step outside that.
watch: pull now vs save for the next one
ache.tip: If you’re deciding against a timer, let the timer win. Missing a banner is calmer than chasing one.
lines: 8h 8m left. I have all the time in the world
save or pull? there’s door number three
the clock is loud. you can turn it down

textData.text: Join me as I share my final thoughts on Zhu Yuan just before the banner resets in 8 hours and 8 minutes. I'll discuss her accessibility for fast team creation, her role as a burst DPS, and her synergy with other characters like Nicole. Should you pull for her? I'll weigh the pros and cons, and talk about the challenges of saving resources for future characters like Qingyi and the Sons of Calydon. Don't forget to leave your experiences and decisions in the comments!
